name: AutoDelete
short: Auto-delete command invocations and bot responses after a delay.
description: Cleans up after prefix commands: removes the invoking message and the bot's replies after a configurable delay, with per-guild settings and channel/command exclusions.
author: Malvinarum
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores channel and command names you choose to exclude, plus per-guild settings. It stores no personal data.
